Description
: Discover a set of three vintage Yello-Bole tobacco pipes, each crafted from imported briar and featuring the classic yellow bowl lining and signature yellow dot on the stem. This trio showcases both darker and lighter brown finishes, adding collectibility and display appeal for tobacciana enthusiasts. Each pipe measures roughly 6 inches long, making them easy to handle and suitable for both display and functional use. The bowls show very gentle signs of prior use but retain good internal structure and are clean, while the stems display characteristic minor surface marks from age and storage. Yello-Bole pipes are renowned for their durability and smooth smoking experience, attributed to their briar wood construction and signature lining. Whether you are an avid collector or simply appreciate mid-century craftsmanship, this set offers practical value and nostalgic charm. Please note visible wear and some interior discoloration, consistent with age and normal prior use. Overall, these pipes remain in solid collectible and usable condition, ready to grace any tobacciana collection.
